reviews.comment: There are 3 exams and one paper, exams are super easy just show up to class and review day!
Great proffesor. He cares about teaching you the content rather than giving you so many assignments. You get 10 unexcused absences, there is only 2 exams, there is one paper, and one field trip.

Dr. Mestrovic is awesome. I took the online class, which had recorded lectures, but I bet the in-person class would be so much fun. There were only two exams and one paper that was graded as pass/fail.

Dr. Mestrovic has been the best professor I have had throughout my entire academic career. Attendance is graded but his lectures are incredibly insightful, personable, and fun and I looked forward to his classes every week. Extremely fair and genuinely cares about students. Definitely take a class with him if you have the opportunity.

This was my second class with Mestrovic and he is honestly one of the best professors that I have had. He teaches in the most interesting manner and really wants students to be able to fully understand the topics that he talks about. Most of the grades come from the two tests in this class with about 3 papers. Attendance was required but worth it.

Dr. Mestrovic is my favorite professor at A&M. I looked forward to his lectures for he is extremely funny, and he really wanted us to enjoy his class. The exams were easy if you attended the exam reviews and put in a little effort into studying. I would take his class again if I could. One paper at the end of the sem. over any topic he covered.

Dr. Mestrovic is an amazing professor who challenges you to apply concepts learned in class. Paying attention is important because he does not use PowerPoint slides, luckily our TA uploads notes. There is not much outside of class work, just a few essays that do not take long. Exams are easy as long as you pay attention and put in some effort.
reviews.ratingTags: Participation matters--Lecture heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Amazing professor! You have to attend his lecture to overall get a easy A, but his exams are really easy, He cares about his students and making connections with them.

This prof is old-school in a good way. Lectures entertaining, interactive, interesting material, conversation based, no powerpoints (not hard to take notes). Tests aren't difficult if you listened, took notes, and studied. Uses books to teach but reads them in class. 3 exams, 3 short essays. Professor is awesome and funny and I will take him again.

This was the best class I've taken in college so far. Mestrovic is the best! The class was super easy and his lectures were funny and great. 3 exams based on lectures and a research paper. He does an exam review before the day of the exam and gives you the questions and has the students shout out the answers. Any class that he teaches take him!

Dr. Mestrovic is one of my favorite sociology professors! He made learning so much fun and his lectures are pretty deep. He has been pretty inspirational to me and his lectures have given me a new perspective in life. I think it is important to go into his class with an open-mind and you will learn so much.
I truly looked forward to this class, and could not recommend it to someone enough. He is such an amazing and awesome teacher who makes his class both easy and enjoyable.

The class is graded on 3 exams. There is also an end of semester paper on a topic of your choice that will add 5 points to your overall grade. He is so chill and hilarious! Very low stress class. He gives students the answers to the exams the class prior to exam day. Please take him!
reviews.ratingTags: EXTRA CREDIT--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: premise of his class is basically old days good and gen z soft.  parades himself as an enlightened moderate but the mask slips off relatively quickly. discourages critical thinking and will laugh at & patrionize you in front of class for countering his ill informed points. if this man can receive a sociology degree so can you.

such a good prof. 100% would take his class again if i could.

the class is test based (3 tests) + 1 paper (2 pages double spaced). both of them were easy!

the class itself is interesting, you can tell he cares about the subject and making it interesting for students instead of just grades.

definitely take his class if you can!!

This guy is probably one of the best professors I've ever had in my life. He doesn't assign busy work, the class is super straight forward, and it's incredibly easy. I took this class as a blow off class, but his lectures were really interesting and he encourages engagement with the class. Super easy to communicate with and would 100% take again.
3 exams for the entire class grade, all multiple choice. Super fun, super easy, just show up and pay attention.
It is insanely easy, reviews before test are basically the exams themselves. Never paid attention, studied the night before, and got 95+ on all exams, which are the only grades.

Take him! Overall super easy class as long as you go to lectures and take good notes. His reviews before the test are very very helpful and help you get at least a 90 on the test. He is hard to hear especially in a big class so make sure to sit at the front and he does ask for students' opinions and examples a lot during class.

I loved this course. He cares more about you actually learning rather than a heavy course load, NO busy work. Easy exams/essays. He is so knowledgeable in all aspects in sociology. Definitely take a course by him. He wants the class to engage in his lectures, so he will be asking the class many questions.

Dr. Mestrovic is my favorite professor at A&M. He is truly one of a kind & cares about teaching. He graduated from Harvard so he is extremely smart, and even had a few famous sociologists as his professors! He teaches this class in a way that fosters true learning & application to the modern day world. I cannot say enough good things he is amazing.

Only 3 papers, but if you went to him and asked for help before starting your paper, he would. Very interesting lectures all the time. I really loved the class and the way he teaches. Make sure to bring your laptop and take notes because he has no powerpoint slides but that should be something you shouldn't worry about. Overall, great professor.
reviews.ratingTags: Clear grading criteria--Hilarious--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: I absolutely loved SOCI 489, Dr. Mestrovic is the best! 3 essays over anything discussed in class. He has really interesting lectures over court cases he was an expert witness in. He is overall such a great guy and i plan to take another class from him. TAKE HIM!!!!! DO IT! Best prof at A&M!
There are no homework, quizzes, or exams. Your grade is based on 3 papers, each 3 full pages, double-spaced, and Times New Roman on any topic or sociologist we have discussed in class.
reviews.ratingTags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Graded by few things--Hilarious

reviews.comment: No quizzes and no exams, only 2-page double-spaced papers due every two weeks on the discussed sociologist.

I highly recommend Dr. Mestrovic! He is so intelligent and makes all the lectures so entertaining. He loves feedback from students so he heavily encourages participation in the lectures. Only three short papers that were really easy. I made 100 on all of them. He is very helpful outside of class and really cares about his students.
reviews.ratingTags: Gives good feedback--Accessible outside class--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: Favorite professor ever. Takes attendance but lectures are so interesting. Only grades are 3 tests, not too hard. He's funny, wants you to participate in class, and cancels class around holidays.

Absolute best professor I've ever had! He truly cares about his students and makes the subject so interesting to where you actually want to go to class everyday. Get ready to be roasted for being a millennial-but he is the funniest guy you'll ever meet! 1000% recommend. Life changer!!!

Such a great professor! He really enjoyed actually teaching us, and class discussion occured every class. He definitly believes more in learning than in grades. He made it a breeeze to understand social theory, and I feel like I still could rember and apply all of it! He is also really funny. Highy reccomend!
reviews.ratingTags: Gives good feedback--Graded by few things--Hilarious

reviews.comment: Professor Mestrovic is by far the most accomplished professor I have ever had and his insights are unparalleled in depth and epistemological thought. He is easily accessible and approachable, he is not concerned with grading, but with producing thought in his students. He is easy in grading to be truthful in discussions. He is very encouraging.

Dr. Mestrovic is certainly an interesting man. I enjoyed the class and it was an easy A; too easy. I felt that the ease of the class was an excuse for him to not put forth a high level of commitment to us. This should have been a discussion-based course but that was nearly impossible because of the size of the class (Texas A&M's fault here).
He is a wonderful teacher!!! take him!! easy grade if you do the work and he explains concepts and relates them to real life which is awesome!!
reviews.ratingTags: Skip class? You won't pass.--SO MANY PAPERS--Hilarious

reviews.comment: Dr. Mestrovic is those type of professors that genuinely cares about his students' success. I highly suggest you contact him to meet during his office hours. If he knows you on a first named basis, he will make sure you are successful in the course. To do well, pay extra attention in class and write detailed notes. His exams are not hard at all.

I loved the courses I took with Dr. Mestrovic. Show up to class, listen to his lecture, and you're sure to get an A. Easiest exams I took my entire undergrad because most answers are obvious from lecture. His lectures are always fun because he's not boring to listen to & always has a funny story or comment to share. Highly recommended!!

Talks a lot about opinions but doesnt really deal with facts... sitting in his classes is like listening to a radio talk show... opinions but doesnt back it with evidence... i think his class is like sociology "light"

Stop what you're doing and register for Mestrovic's class. He is a great professor! His tests were VERY easy! All you need to do is go to class and take notes. His lectures are very interesting and engaging. Mestrovic is a solid choice! You must take his class!

Best professor I have had at A&M! He is great and knows so much. His class is easy, he makes it that way so that the people who actually want to learn will focus on learning. He really changed how I viewed my studies and is the reason I picked up a sociology major! Take him!

I loved Dr. Mestrovic! I took his course writing-intensive and it was definitely challenging, but I seriously finished that course feeling as though I learned a lot. He took attendance and apparently would fail students for missing 6 classes or something. I highly recommend attending every class, because his comments make the material clear.
reviews.ratingTags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Hilarious--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: best prof I've had at A&M. he is brilliant & has a passion for sociology that translates in his lectures. class isn't hard if you pay attention and get engaged in conversations. definitely recommend taking Mestrovic!!

Hands down the best professor I have taken at A&M. He engages you in lectures and applies all theories to everyday life. He does a fantastic job explaining everything you need to know for exams. An all around AWESOME professor. His class is one of the few I actually looked forward to attending. I definitely recommend taking Mestrovic!!
Awesome teacher!!!
Great guy as long as you are active in discussions.

This professor is a true conservative with a passion for everything America stands for. In addition, he is a tireless advocate of both the U.S. military and capitalism both of which he believes the rest of the world should in envy of.

do not leave A&M without taking this professor.  This guy is absolutely brilliant and presents material to you in a way that will transform you in ways you never thought possible.  i never missed a class in two semesters.  it changed my life. best prof i had at A&M.

NO ATTENDANCE POLICY! Best Sociology professor at A&M.  After a test, if you can prove a reason why you answered a question a certain way, the whole class gets credit.  I scored 26 extra points on a test that way.  Somewhat controversial, but one of the United States' foremost experts on post-modernism.  Fascinating lectures, and the reason why I majored in SOCI.
